LanguageData.DMS_Stele_GlyphLostText: We left the impact site without its glyph, and it was lost with the site.\n\nAnother glyph signal will surface in time.
LanguageData.DMS_Stele_GlyphDestroyedText: The glyph server at the impact site was destroyed, and the glyph sealed inside it went with it.\n\nAnother glyph signal will surface in time.
LanguageData.DMS_Stele_SteleSecuredText:
The stele is ours.

Install it at the colony and build a decoder flush against its front. Once powered, the decoder extracts the stele's knowledge into occultech research on its own.

Every stele read this way is lost to the fleets for good.
LanguageData.DMS_Stele_SteleLostText: The stele did not leave the vault with us, and it is lost.\n\nThe resolved glyph cipher still points to other burial sites. Our researchers will work out the next one within a few days.
